creative.body:
If you’ve been relying on Miralax every morning but haven't had a real bathroom visit in days, there is a biological reason why it isn't working.

GLP-1 medications slow down your stomach to keep you full. But when food sits there for too long, it starts to ferment—causing those dreaded sulfur burps and severe, painful bloating.

Here is the secret no one tells you: Standard laxatives work on your colon (the exit). But your "traffic jam" is happening upstream in your paralyzed stomach. You cannot fix an upstream problem by forcing the downstream doors open.

In this video, a GI motility specialist explains exactly why your current routine is failing, and reveals a gentle, 3-step protocol to "wake up" your stomach without harsh chemicals.

Keep the weight loss. Ditch the digestive nightmare.
creative.title: You Finally Found the Weight Loss Miracle... So Why Does Your Stomach Feel Like Concrete?
